name: unbox_sneaker
views: the outer side view, toe pointing LEFT, the red swoosh
the inner side view, toe pointing RIGHT
the top view looking down onto the laces and toe box
the bottom view showing the red rubber outsole and tread
story: Why: she just got these sneakers and checks every side before wearing them. Lift, turn to the toe, tilt to the outsole, set it back.
storyboard_prompt: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Every panel: First-person view at her eye level looking down about 30 degrees at a worn light oak table by a window, 35mm lens, no zoom, no cuts. Handheld: the frame drifts and bobs slightly with her breathing, focus breathes and lands a moment late. Low warm window daylight from the left, one side of everything lit, soft real shadows falling to the right. Lived-in table: a coffee ring, a few crumbs and a folded receipt, framing slightly off-centre. Only her hands and forearms are visible, no face. Only the same young woman's hands and forearms: real skin with fine pores, knuckle creases, a faint vein on the back of the hand, slightly dry fingertips, short soft-pink nails with a tiny chip. Exactly two hands and exactly one sneaker in each panel: one low-top white leather sneaker with a slim low-profile silhouette: smooth white leather upper with fine creases at the toe flex, perforated white toe box, white overlays, one long curved red leather swoosh on the side panel, a red leather heel tab, flat white laces, a padded white tongue, a thin white midsole and a thin flat red rubber outsole. Panel 1 (top left): the sneaker stands on the table at the centre in a side view, toe pointing LEFT, the red swoosh facing the camera; both hands rest flat on the table on either side of it. Panel 2 (top right): both hands hold the WHOLE sneaker level a few centimetres above the table, the RIGHT hand at the heel collar, the LEFT hand under the toe; still a side view, toe LEFT. Panel 3 (bottom left): both hands hold the WHOLE sneaker turned to a front three-quarter view: the toe points toward the camera and slightly LEFT, showing the perforated toe box, the laces and the red swoosh. Panel 4 (bottom right): both hands hold the WHOLE sneaker tilted heel-up so the bottom faces the camera, showing the thin red rubber outsole and its tread with a little real dust in the grooves. The same camera position, table, light and hands in all four panels; the sneaker the same size, about as long as her forearm. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
